alice.release: Starting rollout for v2.14.0 to prod in 15m. Change window 22:00-23:30 PT. Deploy bot queued: <https://deploy.redwood.internal/ops/1752001234|deploy/1752001234> :rocket:

deploy-bot: Release started by alice.release. Stage: canary -> 10% traffic. Logs: <https://ci.redwood/logs/1752001234|ci logs>

bob.oncall: noted. Oncall coverage: me and frank for the window. I'll be on pager.

dana.prodeng: Reminder: DB migration is online-safe; double-check feature-flag rollout. If we need to backout, use flag toggle `ff_v2_14_disable` first.

eli.qa: Running smoke tests now. Posting results in 10m.

frank.sre: Backout plan link in runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood/internal/rollback-v2.14.0|rollback runbook>. TL;DR:
- If 5xx spike > 0.5% sustained for 3m, abort canary and pin traffic back to v2.13.8.
- If L7 latency > 200ms p95 for 10m, roll back canary.
- Emergency circuit: `curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/rollout -d '{"version":"v2.13.8"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN'`

alice.release: smoke green. Proceeding to 50% at +20m. ETA 22:35 PT.

bob.oncall: If rollback needed, follow runbook steps 2-5. I'll open incident channel #inc-1752001234 if we trigger.

eli.qa: smoke ok at 50%. Sanity checks for embeddings & chat flows passed.

deploy-bot: Canary at 50% complete. No errors reported.

frank.sre: Quick note: if control-plane unreachable, fallback: scale down new deployment and re-route via legacy ingress `ingress-legacy-prod`.

alice.release: 50%->100% starting. Rolling deployment now.

frank.sre: Monitoring thresholds set. Alert policy `prod-release-v2` active.

bob.oncall: all good from infra side.

eli.qa: Minor regression in chat formatting spotted at 100% — sending repro gist: <https://gist.github.com/eli/aaa111|repro>

dana.prodeng: Can we patch quickly? severity: low. If not, re-pin to v2.13.8 until fix.

alice.release: Deciding to pin for safety. Triggering backout now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by alice.release. Target version v2.13.8. Steps:
1) Disable feature flag `ff_v2_14_disable=false` -> true
2) Roll traffic to v2.13.8
3) Verify health checks
4) Post-mortem link placeholder

frank.sre: Rollback in progress. Watch for DB connection errors during transition.

bob.oncall: I'll confirm once all nodes report healthy. Toggling flag.

bob.oncall: All nodes healthy, traffic pinned to v2.13.8. Closing deploy thread. :white_check_mark:

alice.release: Thanks team — creating follow-up runbook update and PR to lock the release until regression fixed.

eli.qa: Filing bug with repro and test coverage request.

frank.sre: Postmortem created: <https://incidents.redwood/1752001234-postmortem|postmortem>. Needs timeline and root cause.

alice.release: Good catch everyone. We'll re-schedule patch release next Tuesday in change window.
